name: TeleCanor Global Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1991, TeleCanor Global Ltd is transitioning from a traditional telecom support services provider to a company with primary focus on technology-driven services, particularly blockchain solutions and payment gateways.[1] Also exploring Aquaculture.[2]
keyPoints:
Services Offered:
a) Blockchain-as-a-Service Platform (tBaaS):[1] Private Permissioned Ethereum, Public Ethereum Service, Hyperledger Service, Enterprise Blockchain consulting, Hyperledger Fabric solutions for Banking Industry, Blockchain based Payment Networks, Crypto Currencies, Crypto Exchanges, Wallet Development
b) Payment Gateway:[2] Telecom, Core Banking, ERP, Mobile Apps

cons: Promoters have pledged or encumbered 26.7% of their holding.
Company has high debtors of 649 days.
